gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed GBM (WHO grade 4) patients with maximal surgical resection

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to explore the effects of Vebreltinib in primary glioblastoma patients receiving a combination therapy of chemotherapy (temozolomidel) and MET-TKI.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed GBM (WHO grade 4) patients with maximal surgical resection
Any previous postoperative treatment except for concurrent chemoradiotherapy;

role_evidence.quote: Participants received Vebreltinib (300 mg Bid) in combination with Temozolomide (150 mg/m2) treatment, every 4 weeks for up to 6 cycles (Induction).
Participants received Temozolomide (150 mg/m2) treatment, every 4 weeks for up to 6 cycles (Induction).

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Temozolomide is the active comparator and the backbone in the experimental arm (adjuvant cycles after chemoradiation). Vebreltinib is the only investigational agent. c-MET overexpression by IHC is an entry requirement for all patients and matches the MET-TKI.
